name: candidate_count_1
prompt_text:

A randomly selected unit returns positive. What is the probability that this unit has the fault?

Estimate the probability of the target event using five plausible estimates and their relative weights. Use output scale 0 to 100, where 100 denotes certainty. Decimals and repeated values are allowed. Weights must be nonnegative and sum to one. Use the same posterior probability target for every estimate.
